name: Lopper Road Tunnel
facts: The Lopper Road Tunnel, opened in 1984, stretches 1,590 metres beneath the Lopper, a shoulder of Mount Pilatus that juts into Lake Lucerne, linking Hergiswil and Alpnach.
Designed with just two lanes—one per direction—and no central reservation, the Lopper Road Tunnel exemplifies efficient Swiss motorway engineering within a tight 1,590‑metre span.
Adjacent to the Lopper Tunnel, the Kirchenwald Tunnel on the A2 motorway shares a 350‑metre single‑lane link tunnel, creating a unique junction for westbound traffic between the two motorways.
